mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.student_id, s.entry_year, p.class_code, p.current_page, p.is_submitted, p.last_heartbeat, p.progress_detail, u.nick_name as student_name, s.student_no FROM biz_guide_sheet_progress p LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY p.class_code, s.student_no

SELECT s.student_id, s.student_no, s.entry_year, s.class_code, u.nick_name as student_name, COALESCE(p.current_page, 0) as current_page, COALESCE(p.is_submitted, 'N') as is_submitted, p.last_heartbeat, p.id, CASE WHEN p.is_submitted = 'Y' THEN CONCAT('{"type":"grading","totalScore":', COALESCE(ans.total_score, 0), ',"details":', COALESCE(ans.grading_detail, '[]'), '}') ELSE p.progress_detail END as progress_detail, ans.answer_json FROM biz_guide_sheet_assignment a INNER JOIN biz_student s ON s.class_code = a.class_code AND s.entry_year = a.entry_year INNER JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id AND u.dept_id = a.dept_id LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_progress p ON s.student_id = p.student_id AND p.sheet_id = #{sheetId} LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_answer ans ON s.student_id = ans.student_id AND ans.sheet_id = #{sheetId} WHERE a.sheet_id = #{sheetId} AND a.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND a.class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY s.student_no

SELECT s.student_id, s.student_no, s.entry_year, s.class_code, u.nick_name as student_name, COALESCE(p.current_page, 0) as current_page, COALESCE(p.is_submitted, 'N') as is_submitted, p.last_heartbeat, p.id, CASE WHEN p.is_submitted = 'Y' THEN CONCAT('{"type":"grading","totalScore":', COALESCE(ans.total_score, 0), ',"details":', COALESCE(ans.grading_detail, '[]'), '}') ELSE p.progress_detail END as progress_detail, ans.answer_json FROM biz_guide_sheet_assignment a INNER JOIN biz_student s ON s.class_code = a.class_code AND s.entry_year = a.entry_year INNER JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id AND u.dept_id = a.dept_id LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_progress p ON s.student_id = p.student_id AND p.sheet_id = #{sheetId} LEFT JOIN biz_guide_sheet_answer ans ON s.student_id = ans.student_id AND ans.sheet_id = #{sheetId} WHERE a.sheet_id = #{sheetId} ORDER BY s.class_code, s.student_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_guide_sheet_progress (sheet_id, student_id, class_code, current_page, is_submitted, last_heartbeat, progress_detail) VALUES (#{sheetId}, #{studentId}, #{classCode}, #{currentPage}, #{isSubmitted}, #{lastHeartbeat}, #{progressDetail}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_page = VALUES(current_page), is_submitted = IF(is_submitted = 'Y', 'Y', VALUES(is_submitted)), last_heartbeat = VALUES(last_heartbeat), progress_detail = VALUES(progress_detail)
